I cannot generate the Problem List Clinical Note because the required transcript and DDx JSON were not included. Please provide the consult transcript and the differential diagnosis JSON. 

What I need
- Full consult transcript (doctor–patient conversation). 
- DDx JSON output from the diagnostic reasoning model.
- If any items are sensitive, you may redact identifiers; clinical content (symptoms, timeline, meds, allergies, vitals, exam findings) must remain.

Preferred format
- Paste the transcript between markers (e.g., <<< transcript >>>) and the DDx JSON between markers (e.g., <<< ddx >>>), or attach both as plain text.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, indicate that this is expected and I will mark it as “dose/route/frequency not documented.”

Examples of useful items to include (if not already in the transcript)
- Presenting complaint, onset, duration, progression
- Current medications and allergies
- Past medical history
- Relevant exam findings and vitals
- Social history (smoking, alcohol, living situation)
- Preventive care items (screening tests, immunizations)

When you send both items I will:
- Treat the transcript as the primary source and use DDx only when consistent with the transcript.
- Produce the Problem List Clinical Note with the exact headings and structure you requested.
- Include quality checks and note any missing expected elements or conflicts.

Document quality (current)
- Missing: consult transcript and DDx JSON — cannot proceed.
- Conflict noted: N/A until inputs provided.
- Transcript quality: N/A until transcript provided.
